discussion_points.title: Call grading: shifting off the composite score to the Open and Concerns stages
discussion_points.detail: Now that the script is finalized we are not chasing a final grade this quarter. The measure that matters is movement in the two stages we rewrote. Two v3 weeks and 663 calls give a clean pre-v4 baseline: Open 56.3% of 10 pts, Their Concerns 69.3% of 30 pts, combined 66.0% of 40. Open is the weaker of the two and the one that slipped, so coaching starts there. Treat all of it as baseline rather than progress: both weeks were graded before v4 reached anyone, and a 0.7 point move on two data points is noise. What I need from the room: rubric v3 grades by section number and v4 reorders them, so the renumber has to land before the first week reps are graded on the new flow, or we are scoring new-flow calls against the old map and the baseline is worthless. That is the gate, not any given Monday run. Consequence stated plainly: the Green bar question goes on hold with this. We are tracking stage improvement, not a composite against 65 or 80. If Cameron still wants a Q3 number on 31 Oct I would rather have that conversation now than on 1 Nov.
